title: Analysis and Approximation of Stochastic Multiscale Subdiffusion Driven by Fractional Gaussian Noise
summary: This paper investigates a stochastic multiscale subdiffusion model driven by fractional Gaussian noise, where the multiscale Abel kernel with variable exponent $α(t)\in(0,1)$ is used to capture multiscale and crossover behavior in anomalous diffusion. The main difficulties of this model lie in the complexity of the multiscale Abel kernel (e.g. non-monotonicity and non-coercivity) and the low regularity caused by the noise.
